outline: This course is served to international students who are at intermediate level. Students must be up to B1 level(HSK4). The course will be included Chinese culture, thoughts via Chinese fable to present how the Chinese think. Frequently listening and speaking are necessary in this class.  Writing and reading are the skills which be enhanced in this class too. So assignments will be required.
